extraction.NOTES: Allotment covers the W½ of Sec. 33, T. 37N. R. 36W., 6th P.M., in South Dakota; health is poor, suffering from rheumatism and gall stone troubles; husband's sight is failing; three minor children to support; in 1918, her four boys joined the United States Army, two serving overseas, one of these got killed in France, and the other two served in the United States; has never received any help from the County or the United States Government; document number No. 4447; subscribed and sworn November 16, 1928 | TASK 5 BULK ALLOTMENT RECOVERY 2026-04-29: Sonnet text-extraction captured the allotment number from the source page header but classified it in NOTES as a 'document number' / 'Document No.' / 'No. NNNN' instead of placing it in the structured Allotment number field. The hypothesis that these document/file references are actually allotment numbers was confirmed via BLM cross-reference (exemplars: Eugene Means 2249, Lucy Patton 6802). This patch corrects 49 records via bulk regex extraction from NOTES with user-supervised review of every HIGH-confidence proposal.
